forms.ex: Sie leitet die Abteilung seit drei Jahren.
forms.exEn: She has run the department for three years.

forms.en: head, manager (of a team, a school); conductor (of heat)
forms.clue: the head, the manager (of a team)
forms.ex: Er ist der Leiter der Schule.
forms.exEn: He's the head of the school.
forms.note: die Leiter (ladder) is a different word with its own article.

forms.ex: Der Abteilungsleiter hat das Projekt genehmigt.
forms.exEn: The head of department approved the project.
forms.note: Stress on -tei-: Abteilung (department) is stressed on its second syllable.

forms.ex: Der Projektleiter plant jede Woche ein kurzes Treffen.
forms.exEn: The project manager sets up a short meeting every week.

forms.ex: Viele Geräte brauchen Halbleiter aus Asien.
forms.exEn: Many devices need semiconductors from Asia.
forms.why: Leiter here is a conductor of electricity; halb = half: a material that conducts only partly.

forms.clue: the management; a pipe or cable line
forms.ex: Sie übernimmt die Leitung des Projekts.
forms.exEn: She is taking over the management of the project.

forms.ex: Kann ich bitte ein Glas Leitungswasser haben?
forms.exEn: Can I have a glass of tap water, please?
forms.why: Leitung (water pipe) + Wasser: water from the pipe.
forms.note: das Leitungswasser: a compound takes the article of its last part (das Wasser).

forms.en: guide, guidelines (a short handbook); common thread
forms.ex: Die Firma hat einen Leitfaden für neue Mitarbeiter geschrieben.
forms.exEn: The company has written a guide for new employees.
forms.why: A thread (Faden) that leads you through a maze: a guide.

forms.en: key interest rate, base rate (of a central bank)
forms.ex: Die Zentralbank hat den Leitzins erhöht.
forms.exEn: The central bank has raised the key interest rate.
forms.why: Leit- = leading: the interest rate (Zins) that all others follow.

forms.ex: Der Leitartikel kritisiert die neue Steuer.
forms.exEn: The editorial criticises the new tax.
forms.why: Leit- = leading: the paper's leading article, its own opinion.

forms.ex: Sie arbeitet als leitende Ärztin im Krankenhaus.
forms.exEn: She works as a senior doctor at the hospital.

forms.en: initiate, start (steps, a procedure); introduce (a text); discharge (into a river)
forms.ex: Die Regierung hat Reformen eingeleitet.
forms.exEn: The government has initiated reforms.
forms.why: ein = into: you lead a process into motion.

forms.en: introduction (of a text, a talk); initiation (of steps)
forms.ex: Die Einleitung deines Aufsatzes ist zu lang.
forms.exEn: The introduction to your essay is too long.

forms.ex: Daraus lässt sich eine klare Regel ableiten.
forms.exEn: A clear rule can be derived from this.
forms.why: ab = off, from: you lead one thing off from another.

forms.en: derivation (of a word, a formula); deduction
forms.ex: Die Ableitung dieses Wortes ist nicht ganz klar.
forms.exEn: The derivation of this word is not entirely clear.

forms.ex: Wegen der Baustelle wird der Verkehr umgeleitet.
forms.exEn: Traffic is being diverted because of the roadworks.
forms.why: um = around: you lead the traffic around an obstacle.

forms.ex: Nach dem Unfall mussten alle Autos eine Umleitung fahren.
forms.exEn: After the accident all cars had to take a detour.

forms.en: forward, pass on (an email, a request)
forms.ex: Kannst du mir die E-Mail bitte weiterleiten?
forms.exEn: Can you forward me the email, please?
forms.why: weiter = on, further: you lead it on to the next person.

forms.ex: Die automatische Weiterleitung der Anrufe funktioniert nicht.
forms.exEn: The automatic call forwarding isn't working.

forms.ex: Ein erfahrener Kollege leitet die neuen Mitarbeiter an.
forms.exEn: An experienced colleague guides the new staff.
forms.why: an = on, at: you lead someone on while they work.

forms.ex: Lies zuerst die Anleitung, bevor du das Gerät benutzt.
forms.exEn: Read the instructions before you use the device.

forms.clue: to tempt, to lead astray (into a mistake)
forms.ex: Die niedrigen Preise verleiten viele Leute zu Spontankäufen.
forms.exEn: The low prices tempt many people into impulse buys.
forms.why: ver = off course: you lead someone the wrong way.

forms.en: lead on (to the next topic), make a transition
forms.clue: to make the transition (to the next topic)
forms.ex: Danach leitet der Moderator zum nächsten Thema über.
forms.exEn: Then the presenter moves on to the next topic.
forms.why: über = over, across: you lead the listeners across to a new point.

forms.en: transition, link (in a text, a talk)
forms.ex: Die Überleitung zum zweiten Teil war sehr gelungen.
forms.exEn: The transition to the second part worked very well.
